newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks rise across board, end 4.36 pct up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks rise across board, end 4.36 pct up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose across the board on Thursday on technical correction and ended 4.36 percent up, dealers said. They said the index was poised for a rise on short-covering when the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) reopens after the Friday-Saturday weekend.

The KSE 100-share index closed 60.07 points up at 1,438.42, slightly less than the last big rise of 66.60 points on March 28. Gainers outpaced losers 201 to 71 in a turnover of 49 million shares, up from Wednesday's 31 million.
"The 4.36 percent rise in the index outlines some significant across the board rises," one dealer said.
